notes: Basket Protocol index vault for Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). Contracts-only deployment of BaskVault; no separate launch token, pool or website. Basket (BASK) is the vault's own ERC-20 share with 18 decimals, zero supply at deployment and no supply cap: deposits mint shares and redemptions burn shares. Constructor arguments are the approved owner and guardian literals, in that order; the constructor rejects zero or equal roles and makes no external calls. STOCK_FACTORY is fixed in source at 0x4783C67b63dE2B358Ac5951a7D41F47A38F3C046. The vault starts with an empty asset list and an unset feeRecipient. The owner lists at least three assets and finalizes genesis; deposits open 72 hours later subject to the market gate, prices, balances and caps. These are later application operations, not deployment initialization calls. The owner may set the fee recipient once, finally. Deposit and redemption fees are fixed at 0.5%. Owner and guardian powers cannot pause redeem or claim. Failed redemption payments become claimable debt. The vault has no proxy, upgrade, rescue or sweep authority. Accepted design risks: (1) deposit-then-redeem profit is possible when a feed lags more than the 1% round-trip fee; (2) the owner is trusted to pair each token with its true feed; (3) an untransferable asset keeps its feed value until deposits are paused. Stock Token issuers can pause, block or burn holders and upgrade their tokens.
